lede.sr: Dvadeset dva zavedena prisustva. 15 radova iz reciklaže tekstila je fotografisano (21 fotografija) — od skica i listova sa idejama do prvih uzoraka i prototipova; 7 zapisa je bez fotografije.
lede.en: Twenty-two recorded attendances. 15 textile-recycling works were photographed (21 photographs) — from sketches and idea sheets to first samples and prototypes; 7 entries have no photograph.

description.sr: Profesorovi zapisi devetog časa (27.11.2026), uneti na samom času redom obilaska: 22 zapisa, 15 fotografisanih radova iz reciklaže tekstila sa 21 fotografijom i 7 zapisa bez fotografije.
description.en: The professor’s records of the ninth class (27 November 2026), entered during the class in the order of the round: 22 entries, 15 photographed textile-recycling works with 21 photographs and 7 entries without a photograph.

napomena.sr: Svaki fotografisani zapis otvara stranicu svog rada; brojevi su brojevi fotografija po zapisu, ne ocene.
napomena.en: Every photographed entry opens its work’s page; the numbers count photographs per entry, not grades.

udruzenjeNalazi.sr: Deveti čas je protekao u učionici, u radu na reciklaži tekstila; zapisa iz udruženja za ovaj dan nema.
udruzenjeNalazi.en: The ninth class took place in the classroom, working on textile recycling; there are no records from the association for this day.

analizaUdruzenja.sr: Probanje radova u udruženju i ranije posete stoje u Dnevniku i na stranama poseta.
analizaUdruzenja.en: Trials of the works at the association and the earlier visits stand in the Journal and on the visit pages.

napomena.sr: tekstil: skica rama sa paralelnim trakama i dve provučene trake u boji; očekuje se prototip, a izrada rama još treba da se reši.
napomena.en: textile: a sketch of a frame with parallel slats and two coloured strips woven through; a prototype is expected, and how the frame is built is still to be resolved.

napomena.sr: tekstil: list sa crtežom rotirajuće kružne osnove sa stubićima i četiri koraka pletenja tekstilne trake.
napomena.en: textile: a sheet with a drawing of a rotating round base with pegs and four steps for knitting a textile strip.

napomena.sr: tekstil: papirna lutka sa preklopima — odeća od ostataka pletiva i tkanine menja se okretanjem preklopa (3 fotografije).
napomena.en: textile: a paper doll with flaps — clothes made of knit and fabric offcuts change as the flaps are turned (3 photographs).

napomena.sr: tekstil: dva odštampana lista — koraci izrade modula i konačni proizvod, prostirka od devet jastučića od recikliranog tekstila.
napomena.en: textile: two printed sheets — the steps for making the modules and the final product, a mat of nine cushions made from recycled textile.

napomena.sr: tekstil: dve ideje na listu — akustična tabla od recikliranog tekstila i senzorna podloga; naziv rada još nije izabran.
napomena.en: textile: two ideas on one sheet — an acoustic panel of recycled textile and a sensory mat; the work has no title yet.

napomena.sr: tekstil: list sa kartom okruga i delovima slagalice u šest boja i šest šara.
napomena.en: textile: a sheet with the map of districts and puzzle pieces in six colours and six patterns.

napomena.sr: tekstil: list sa dva postupka u tri koraka — čarapa od farmerki i rukavice od džempera.
napomena.en: textile: a sheet with two three-step procedures — a stocking from jeans and mittens from a jumper.

napomena.sr: prisustvo zavedeno; za sledeći čas zapisana radionica.
napomena.en: attendance recorded; a workshop is noted for the next class.

napomena.sr: tekstil: probni uzorci — zvezde i komadi od presovane vlaknaste mase u crvenoj, beloj i crno-beloj boji.
napomena.en: textile: trial samples — stars and pieces of pressed fibre pulp in red, white and black-and-white.

napomena.sr: tekstil: tri kartonska rama za tkanje sa utkanim trakama tkanine.
napomena.en: textile: three cardboard weaving frames with fabric strips woven in.

napomena.sr: prisustvo zavedeno, bez fotografije na ovom času.
napomena.en: attendance recorded, no photograph at this class.

napomena.sr: tekstil: digitalni trodimenzionalni model — šestougaoni moduli složeni u ostrvo.
napomena.en: textile: a digital three-dimensional model — hexagonal modules assembled into an island.

napomena.en: attendance recorded, no photograph at this class.

napomena.sr: tekstil: dva kartonska rama za pletenje u krug, sa ciklama i svetloplavim pletivom (2 fotografije).
napomena.en: textile: two cardboard frames for knitting in the round, with magenta and light-blue knitting (2 photographs).

napomena.sr: tekstil: korpica opletena trakama teksasa preko kartonskog valjka (2 fotografije).
napomena.en: textile: a small basket woven from denim strips over a cardboard cylinder (2 photographs).

napomena.sr: tekstil: skice u svesci — skelet od žice ili štapića sa delovima povezanim tkaninom.
napomena.en: textile: notebook sketches — a skeleton of wire or sticks with parts joined by fabric.

napomena.sr: tekstil: list sa skicom rama i beleškama o šablonima po kojima se od tkanine prave slike.
napomena.en: textile: a sheet with a sketch of a frame and notes on templates for making pictures out of fabric.

napomena.en: textile: a white foam-board model with a blue roller and discs (3 photographs).
